name: test-gate
description: Run non-interactive tests outside Codex turns without model polling.

interface.shortDescription: Run automated tests without model polling.
interface.longDescription: Blocks only non-interactive automated test commands launched by Codex and hands them to a detached local runner with an embedded or browser-based dashboard. Interactive browser, screenshot, and UI verification remains available.
defaultPrompt: Open Test Gate for this project.
Defer this project's automated tests to Test Gate.
